content: A jury has found Huawei guilty of stealing US trade secrets, as reported earlier by NBC News and Bloomberg. The verdict, handed down in a federal court in New York, concludes a years-long legal battle that accused the Chinese telecom giant of stealing source code and proprietary technology from several companies, including T-Mobile, Cisco, and Motorola. The Department of Justice’s 2018 criminal indictment against Huawei came to light following the arrest of the company’s CFO, Wanzhou Meng, whom the agency accused of fraud. Though the indictment against Meng was eventually dismissed, she admitted to misleading banks over Huawei’s operations in Iran as part of a deferred prosecution agreement. The US government blacklisted Huawei in 2019 over national security concerns. In total, the jury found Huawei guilty of 10 of 12 criminal counts, including money laundering, violating US sanctions, bank fraud, wire fraud, and conspiracy to defraud the US. The company was acquitted of engaging in a criminal racketeering conspiracy and obstruction of justice. Huawei’s sentencing is set for September 14th, 2027, where it may face “financial penalties including criminal fines, forfeiture, and restitution,” according to the DOJ. “For over two decades, Huawei built its global empire on a foundation of fraud, theft, and deception,” Tysen A. Duva, the assistant attorney general of the DOJ’s criminal division, says in a statement. “Huawei’s crimes threatened the U.S. financial system, took advantage of American companies that compete honestly in the global telecommunications market, and undermined our national security.” In a statement to NBC News, a Huawei spokesperson said the charges are “without legal or factual merit” and that it plans to appeal the decision. Huawei didn’t immediately respond to The Verge’s request for comment. Update, November 24th: Added information from the DOJ.
chineseTitle: 华为被判窃取商业机密罪
chineseSummary: 据 NBC 新闻和彭博社早些时候报道，陪审团裁定华为犯有窃取美国商业机密的罪名。纽约联邦法院做出的这一判决结束了一场长达数年的法律斗争，这场法律斗争指控这家中国电信巨头从多家公司窃取源代码和专有技术，其中包括 T-Mobile、思科和 [...]
chineseContent: 据 NBC 新闻和彭博社早些时候报道，陪审团裁定华为犯有窃取美国商业机密的罪名。纽约联邦法院做出的这一判决结束了一场长达数年的法律诉讼，这场诉讼指控这家中国电信巨头窃取 T-Mobile、思科和摩托罗拉等多家公司的源代码和专有技术。美国司法部 2018 年针对华为的刑事起诉曝光，该公司首席财务官孟晚舟被捕，司法部指控其欺诈。尽管对孟晚舟的起诉最终被驳回，但她承认，作为暂缓起诉协议的一部分，她在华为在伊朗的业务上误导了银行。 2019年，美国政府出于国家安全考虑将华为列入黑名单。陪审团总共裁定华为犯有 12 项犯罪罪名中的 10 项，包括洗钱、违反美国制裁、银行欺诈、电信欺诈以及串谋诈骗美国。该公司因参与勒索共谋犯罪和妨碍司法公正而被判无罪。美国司法部表示，华为的判决定于 2027 年 9 月 14 日进行，届时可能会面临“包括刑事罚款、没收和归还在内的经济处罚”。 “二十多年来，华为在欺诈、盗窃和欺骗的基础上建立了其全球帝国，”美国司法部刑事部门助理总检察长蒂森·A·杜瓦(Tysen A. Duva)在一份声明中表示。 “华为的罪行威胁了美国的金融体系，利用了在全球电信市场诚实竞争的美国公司的利益，并损害了我们的国家安全。”华为发言人在给 NBC 新闻的一份声明中表示，这些指控“没有法律或事实依据”，并计划对这一决定提出上诉。华为没有立即回应
